title: MV/MZ RPG Maker to Android - A lightweight wrapper for MV/MZ projects

posts.author: cellicom
posts.body:
Hi everyone, i'm back!
I've developed this wrapper for myself, but I think it might be useful to someone.
RPG Maker to Android
A lightweight wrapper for MV/MZ projects
cellicom
​
I’d like to share a tool I’ve been working on to simplify the process of porting RPG Maker MV and MZ games to Android:
RPG Maker to Android
.
While there are several ways to deploy to mobile, I wanted to create a straightforward, modern wrapper that handles the heavy lifting of integrating an HTML5 export into a native Android environment using Android Studio.
Link to the Repository:
https://github.com/cellicom/rpgmaker-to-android
Key Features:​
Optimized WebView:
Uses a tailored WebView configuration to ensure the game runs smoothly with minimal overhead.
Full-Screen Support:
Automatically handles immersive mode and aspect ratio scaling.
Save Data Management:
Includes logic to ensure game saves are stored correctly within the Android file system, preventing data loss between sessions.
Hardware Back Button:
Integrated support for the Android back button (mapped to the "Cancel/Menu" action in-game).
Step-by-Step Guide:
The README includes clear instructions on how to import your www folder into Android Studio and generate your APK/AAB.
How to use it:​
Export your project from RPG Maker (MV or MZ) for
Web Browsers
.
Clone the repository and open it in
Android Studio
.
Place your exported
www
folder into the
app/src/main/assets/
directory.
Configure your App Name and Icon in the manifest and resource files.
Build and Run!
Note:​
This is an open-source project and I'm looking for feedback! If you find any bugs or have suggestions for features (like better plugin integration or IAP support), feel free to open an issue on
GitHub
or comment here.
I hope this helps some of you get your games onto the Play Store!
Terms
Free to use in any RPG Maker MV\MZ project including commercial. Credit are appreciated
Enjoy!
